announcements.text: Rogers, Lovelock & Fritz Inc., Orlando, Florida, is awarded an indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, architect-engineering contract with a maximum amount of $127,000,000 for multi-discipline projects at various activities in the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest area of responsibility. The contract’s original ceiling is increased by $27,000,000 to execute new task orders for mission-critical requirements. Work will be performed at various government installations in, but not limited to, Washington (75%), Alaska (22%), Idaho (1%), Montana (1%), and Oregon (1%). Work is expected to be completed by September 2026. Task orders will be primarily funded by fiscal 2026 military construction (Navy) funds. This contract was competitively procured via the Navy Electronic Commerce Online website with four proposals received. Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest, Silverdale, Washington, is the contracting activity (N44255-20-D-0002).

announcements.text: World Wide Technology LLC, St. Louis, Missouri, is awarded a $14,897,521 firm-fixed-price contract for Operational Command Post – Heavy hardware and licenses. This contract provides modular, expeditionary information technology infrastructure to Fleet Marine Forces. This scalable architecture enables the hosting and rapid deployment of secure, enterprise-grade services at the tactical edge within disconnected, intermittent, and limited environments. Work will be performed at St. Louis, Missouri, with an expected completion date of Dec. 3, 2026. The maximum dollar value is $14,897,521 with no option years. Fiscal 2026 procurement (Marine Corps) funds in the amount of $14,897,521 are being obligated at time of award. Contract funds in the amount of $14,897,521 will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured via NASA Solutions for Enterprise-Wide, and two offers were received. Marine Corps Systems Command, Quantico, Virginia, is the contracting activity (M67854-26-F-0135).

announcements.text: Dragoon Technology LLC,* Tucson, Arizona, is awarded a $9,879,151 firm-fixed-price contract for non-recurring engineering activities to integrate energetics into the internally developed Coriolis Unmanned Aerial System (UAS), as well as support multiple test and evaluation events focused on assessing the operational suitability and performance of the Coriolis UAS with onboard collaborative autonomy for multiple systems under Small Business Innovation Research Phase II Topic A234-P017, entitled Engineer Operations, through the Office of the Secretary of War Accelerated Research for Transition program. Work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona (97%); and Tampa, Florida (3%), and is expected to be completed in August 2028. Fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation (Defense Wide) funds in the amount of $8,999,945 will be obligated at the time of award. This contract action was competed via other than full and open competition; one firm solicited, and one offer received. Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Lakehurst, New Jersey, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Environmental Abatement Inc., Layton, Utah, has been awarded a ceiling $9,900,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for abatement services. This contract provides for removal of asbestos, lead-based paint, heavy metals, animal excrement, and other abatement and sampling and inspection activities. Work will be performed at Hill Air Force Base, Utah, and other geographically separated areas under its jurisdiction, and is expected to be completed by Jan. 19, 2034. This contract was a competitive acquisition, and two offers were received. Fiscal 2025 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $250 are being obligated at time of award. The Air Force Sustainment Center, Hill AFB, Utah, is the contracting activity.
